_comment: Guardian (Earth/Ice/Elemental) hero. Once per Turn Defense Reaction - {r}{r}{r}: if an Earth card is pitched this way, prevent the next 2 damage that would be dealt to Oldhim this turn; if an Ice card is pitched this way, the attacking hero puts a card from hand on top of their deck. Modeled as the Earth branch (activation_cost 3 -> PREVENT_DAMAGE 2); the pitch-color branching and the Ice branch are simplified/omitted. NOTE: printing is Living Legend, used here as the Earth/Ice representative for card-testing coverage.
